title: What Is Knee Replacement Surgery?
description: What knee replacement (knee arthroplasty) is, what it is for and when it is recommended. Care in Lima with price options by clinic.
tldr: Knee replacement (arthroplasty) replaces a joint damaged by advanced arthritis to relieve pain and regain mobility. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
Knee replacement (arthroplasty) replaces a joint damaged by advanced arthritis to relieve pain and regain mobility.

How is it done?

The joint surfaces are replaced with prosthetic components; partial or total depending on the wear.

When is it recommended?

Advanced arthritis with pain and limited movement that does not improve with conservative treatment. The orthopedic surgeon decides.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team across different clinics, so you can choose the price option that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

faqs.a: It depends on the procedure and the clinic; the specialist will tell you after the evaluation.

faqs.q: Who decides whether I need it?
faqs.a: The surgeon, after an evaluation with tests.

tldr: Candidates are usually people with advanced arthritis with pain and limited movement that does not improve with conservative treatment. The orthopedic surgeon decides. Final candidacy is determined by the surgeon after an evaluation with tests.

Am I a candidate for knee replacement?

Usual indications

Advanced arthritis with pain and limited movement that does not improve with conservative treatment. The orthopedic surgeon decides.

The evaluation

It includes a medical history and tests, sometimes imaging. It does not depend only on the patient's wishes.

faqs.a: Medication, physical therapy and injections in early stages; a prosthesis when those fail.

title: Risks and Complications of Knee Replacement
description: Risks and possible complications of knee replacement, and how they are reduced with evaluation and follow-up.
tldr: Like any surgery, knee replacement has risks: infection, thrombosis, long-term loosening of the prosthesis and stiffness. They are uncommon and are reduced with a proper evaluation, careful technique and follow-up. The surgeon explains them at the consultation.
bodyHtml:
Learning about the risks of knee replacement is part of making a responsible decision.

Possible complications

Infection, thrombosis, long-term loosening of the prosthesis and stiffness.

How they are reduced

A complete pre-operative evaluation, careful technique and close follow-up. The team's experience influences results.

faqs.a: It is a common procedure; safety depends on the evaluation, the technique and the follow-up.

faqs.q: What warning signs should I watch for?
faqs.a: Fever, increasing pain or swelling, redness, or calf pain (possible thrombosis).
